title: bada-layout/3
description: A layout file (the standard, §7.5): everything a layout is.

format.title: Format
format.description: Always "bada-layout/3". A file of another format is refused (bad-format).

id.title: Id
id.description: The layout's slug: <group>-<name>, in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The group is the language (en, ko, ja) or uni for a layout of no language. Settings, profiles and actions name the layout by it. A stock layout's id makes this file replace that stock layout; a new id makes a new layout, which has no key model (it is ranked against other layouts by its rank scores alone).

name.title: Name
name.description: What lists show, by language (BCP 47 tags). en is required.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: BCP 47: the language of the text it types, which each menu row carries. und for a layout of no language. A user's dictionary words count for the layouts of their language.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: muhenkan: it types directly, and read is direct. henkan: it composes, and read is anything else. Only a muhenkan layout can be the muhenkan layout; either kind can be a candidate of a henkan profile.

read.title: Way of reading
read.description: Which of the engine's general ways of reading the keys. direct: every key types its slot. hangul: jamo compose into syllables. table: letters spell text, by a table of spellings (romaji) or of syllable pieces (romanized Korean). kana: one kana per key, with marks. search: the keys spell a search and the menu lists what it finds. The part of the same name holds that way's tables, and the parts of the other ways must be absent.

note.title: Note
note.description: Where the layout comes from. The engine doesn't read it.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Each key's layers: base (no modifier), shift (⇧), alt (⌥) and alt_shift (⌥⇧). A layer holds one slot, {"t": what the key types there, "r": its role}, or null for a key that types nothing there. A base or shift slot left out is the JIS table's: the legend printed on a JIS keyboard, as a letter (role l) on a letter key where the way of reading has letters, and text (role x) otherwise. alt and alt_shift are the layout's only where listed: elsewhere ⌥ + the key commits what is staged and goes to the app. Space is the layout's only where listed. The keys are the 48 typing keys and Space, by KeyboardEvent.code.

text_ends_word.title: Text ends the word
text_ends_word.description: true: a text slot (role x) commits what shows and then types its character, instead of being staged with the word. Beside another layout that has a non-text slot on that key it is staged as usual. Default false.

convert.title: Conversions
convert.description: What turns the layout's reading into more menu rows. Each item names one of the engine's general conversions (with) and its arguments. They run in the order listed.

oneOf.description: Kanji conversion of a kana reading.

with.description: kanji: kanji conversion of a kana reading.

rows.description: How many conversions are listed, at most.

user_rows.description: How far down the conversions the user's own words are looked for, when the user has words of this language.

common.description: A list of common words by reading, listed under the first conversion.

rows.description: How many of them are listed, at most.

native.description: The buffer that lists words normally written in kana: such a reading's kana ranks first.

kana.description: romaji: the kana row carries its romaji as a note.

converted.description: reading: each converted row carries its kana reading as a note.

oneOf.title: Kanji conversion

oneOf.description: A dictionary lookup of the letters typed.

with.description: dictionary: a dictionary lookup of the letters typed, when every staged key is a letter. Each row's note is the word as typed.

rows.description: How many results are listed, at most.

first.description: false: its rows are never the top row.

below_top.description: How far under the top reading's score its rows start.

case.description: Which of the dictionary's lists is looked in, by how the word was typed.

lower.description: Typed all in lower case. word: the list of words. name: the list of names. name-then-word: both, names first. name-else-word: names, and words only when no name matches.

mixed.description: Typed with a capital first, or mixed. word: the list of words. name: the list of names. name-then-word: both, names first. name-else-word: names, and words only when no name matches.

upper.description: Typed all in capitals. word: the list of words. name: the list of names. name-then-word: both, names first. name-else-word: names, and words only when no name matches.

oneOf.title: Dictionary lookup

oneOf.description: The reading in the other width, as a row.

with.description: width: the reading with its letters, digits and symbols in the other width, as a row just under the reading, where it differs. Kana stay as they are.

to.description: half: a full-width reading's half-width form. full: a half-width reading's full-width form.

oneOf.title: Other width

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: The layout's named actions. A profile binds them to F6–F10, and an action event names one as <layout id>.<action id>. Each has an id, a label by language, and do, one of the engine's general operations.

oneOf.description: The reading in a script, until the commit.

id.description: The action's name within the layout: <layout id>.<action id> names it in a profile's F keys and in action events.

label.description: What the settings show for it, by language. en is required.

do.description: script: shows the reading in a script, until the commit.

to.description: The script: hiragana, katakana, or halfwidth-katakana.

oneOf.title: Script

oneOf.description: The staged keys as their JIS characters, in a width, until the commit.

id.description: The action's name within the layout: <layout id>.<action id> names it in a profile's F keys and in action events.

label.description: What the settings show for it, by language. en is required.

do.description: keys: shows the staged keys as their JIS characters, in a width, until the commit.

oneOf.title: Keys

oneOf.description: One jamo of each syllable of the staged text, else of the selection.

id.description: The action's name within the layout: <layout id>.<action id> names it in a profile's F keys and in action events.

label.description: What the settings show for it, by language. en is required.

do.description: jamo: leaves one jamo of each syllable of the staged text, which stays staged; with nothing staged, of the selection.

keep.description: Which jamo of each syllable stays: initials, vowels or finals.

oneOf.title: Jamo

oneOf.description: A list from a data buffer for the staged text, else for the selection.

id.description: The action's name within the layout: <layout id>.<action id> names it in a profile's F keys and in action events.

label.description: What the settings show for it, by language. en is required.

do.description: lookup: opens a list from a data buffer for the staged text; with nothing staged, for the selection.

data.description: The buffer the list comes from (hanja).

oneOf.title: Lookup

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Other ways of writing what was typed, as the menu's negative entries: the first is entry −1, the second −2, and so on. Each is made from the staged keys and this file alone, so the same keys always give the same forms. They show in a profile that has script_forms on.

oneOf.description: The layout's reading of the keys, in a script.

do.description: script: the layout's reading of the keys, in a script.

to.description: The script: hiragana, katakana, or halfwidth-katakana.

oneOf.title: Script

oneOf.description: The keys as their JIS characters, in a width.

do.description: keys: the keys as their JIS characters, in a width.

oneOf.title: Keys

oneOf.description: One jamo of each syllable of the layout's reading.

do.description: jamo: one jamo of each syllable of the layout's reading.

keep.description: Which jamo of each syllable: initials, vowels or finals.

oneOf.title: Jamo

particles.title: Particles
particles.description: Particles and endings of this layout that may follow a word typed on a direct layout of the same profile, in one staged run: Claude에, GitHubで.

after.description: What a particle may follow. word: a known word of the direct layout. name: a capitalised word its lists don't have.

words.description: The particles and endings, as this layout types them.

stack.description: When particles stack (client들에게): which may come first, and how many in all.

first.description: The particles that may come first in a stack.

max.description: How many particles in a stack, at most.

words.title: Word lists
words.description: The word lists that say which of its readings are known words, by buffer name (ko-words, en-words, ja-words). The user's dictionary counts with them. A buffer the engine wasn't given is a warning (unknown-data), and that list is off.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: The score of each kind of reading, before the profile's weights and the comparison between layouts. The menu lists readings by score, highest first. Leave a field out where the kind of reading can't occur in this layout; a kind with no score gets 50.

known.description: A reading that is a known word: in one of the word lists, or in the user's dictionary.

by_count.description: true: the natural logarithm of the word's count is added to known, so a more common word ranks higher.

rare.description: A reading in a word list's rare section.

letters.description: read direct: letters only, but no known word.

whole.description: Hangul in whole syllables, but no known word.

loose.description: Hangul with loose jamo left over.

unknown.description: Kana that is no known word. With kanji conversion its conversions rank just above it.

broken.description: Kana with a mark left over or Latin letters still pending.

after_text.description: read table: a reading with letters after a text slot that should have ended the word (text_ends_word).

query.description: read search: the search as typed.

found.description: read search: what the search finds; each result a little under the one before.

readings.description: read table, syllable form: how the other readings of the letters rank when one is a known word.

cost.description: Taken from known for each jamo the reading changes from the default one. Splitting the letters elsewhere changes no jamo.

max_cost.description: The most that is taken, however many jamo change.

floor.description: Such a reading never scores under this.

rows.description: How many of them are listed, at most.

model.description: read table, syllable form: when no reading is a known word, a jamo model chooses among them.

cost.description: What each changed jamo costs the reading, as a base-10 logarithm.

margin.description: By how much the model's reading must beat the default to show first, as a base-10 logarithm.

options.title: Options
options.description: The options this layout has in the settings, under options.<layout id> of a profile or of the defaults: a name → its type, default, title and hint. A part of this file that names an option (table.syllable.shortcuts.option, search.sources[].tones) must name one declared here.

default.description: Its value where the settings say nothing.

title.description: What the settings page shows for the option, by language. en is required.

hint.description: A line under it, by language.

type.description: order: some of the values of `of`, in an order.

default.description: The values and their order where the settings say nothing. A value left out is off.

title.description: What the settings page shows for the option, by language. en is required.

hint.description: A line under it, by language.

direct.title: Direct
direct.description: The tables of read direct, where every key types its slot.

variants.description: A character → its variants. In muhenkan, ⌥ + a key whose slot types that character (⌥⇧ for its ⇧ slot), and that has no alt slot of its own, shows the character with its variants as a strip to pick from.

hangul.title: Hangul
hangul.description: The tables of read hangul, where jamo compose into syllables. The reading is precomposed syllables, and compatibility jamo for what makes no syllable.

vowels.description: Two vowels that join into one: "ㅗㅏ": "ㅘ". A vowel after a vowel with no final joins it when the pair is here.

finals.description: Two finals that cluster into one: "ㄱㅅ": "ㄳ". A second final joins the first when the pair is here.

double_tense.description: true: the same initial twice before a vowel, or the same final twice, is its tense form (ㄱ ㄱ → ㄲ; as finals ㄲ and ㅆ only).

final_moves_on.description: true: a vowel after a final takes the last final as the initial of a new syllable, when the slot that typed it has an initial form (role c). A final-only slot (role f) never moves.

implied_ieung.description: true: a vowel with no initial to join starts a syllable on ㅇ. Default false: it shows as a jamo.

table.title: Table
table.description: The tables of read table, where the letter slots (role l) spell text. One of two forms: spellings, for text spelled a piece at a time (romaji), or syllable, for Hangul spelled an onset, a vowel and a coda at a time.

spellings.description: Letters → what they type: "ka": "か". Matched without regard to case.

rules.description: Spellings that look ahead or keep letters. A rule with before comes ahead of a spelling of the same letters.

before.description: The rule applies only when the next letter is one of these; that letter isn't used up. ("nn" → ん before a, i, u, e, o.)

keep.description: How many of its last letters stay pending: "kk" types っ and keeps one k.

oneOf.title: Spellings
oneOf.description: Text spelled a piece at a time (romaji). The pending letters are read whenever one is added: while they begin a longer spelling they wait, and otherwise the longest spelling or rule that begins them is typed.

onsets.description: Initial consonants: a spelling → the jamo it reads, the default first ("ch": ["ㅊ", "ㅈ"]). The longest spelling that matches is tried first.

vowels.description: Vowels: a spelling → the jamo it reads, the default first.

codas.description: Finals: a spelling → the jamo it reads, the default first.

empty_onset.description: The initial of a syllable that starts with a vowel: ["ㅇ"].

vowels_before_coda.description: What a vowel spelling reads instead when a final follows: "yu": ["ㅕ", "ㅠ"].

codas_before.description: What a coda spelling also reads before a given letter.

jamo.description: What the coda also reads there.

letter_after.description: A text slot that is a letter when the letter before it is one of these: "-": ["e"] makes e- a spelling.

shortcuts.description: Other spellings of whole syllables, from a data buffer.

option.description: The option of this layout that turns them on. It must be declared in options.

syllable.description: The syllable pieces: each maps a spelling to the jamo it reads, the default first.

oneOf.title: Syllable
oneOf.description: Hangul spelled an onset, a vowel and a coda at a time (bada roman). A run of letters is read syllable by syllable, the default reading first and every other reading after it, for the ranking.

kana.title: Kana
kana.description: The tables of read kana: a k slot types its kana, and an m slot is a mark that changes the kana before it.

marks.description: Each mark, and what it makes of the kana before it: "゛": {"か": "が"}. Where it makes nothing the mark stays as itself, and the reading is broken.

search.title: Search
search.description: The tables of read search: the staged keys spell a search (letters in lower case), and the menu lists the search as typed, then what it finds, each with a note.

sources.description: What is searched. A result must have, for every word of the search, a word that begins with it. Results of several sources are ordered by tier, then by source.

data.description: The buffer that is searched (unicode-names, symbols, emoji).

match.description: The buffer's columns that are searched, by name.

tiers.description: How its matches rank, best first. exact: the search is the whole first column. whole: a search of one word is a whole word of a column. first: every word of the search begins a word of the first column. any: any other match. A tier left out isn't listed.

order.description: Within a tier. data: the buffer's order. shortest: the shorter first column first.

note.description: The row's note. name: the entry's name. code: U+XXXX and its name.

single.description: A column of characters: a search of one character lists the entries that have it there, and nothing else.

forms.description: With single: a letter or digit that no entry lists offers its other forms: full-width and circled, and a digit's superscript, subscript and roman numeral.

tones.description: The option of this layout that orders an emoji's skin tones; a tone left out of it isn't offered. It must be declared in options.

code.description: A character by its code point, in hex.

max_digits.description: The most hex digits a code has (1–6).

after.description: Prefixes after which any hex digits are a code: "u+" makes u+1f600 a code.

digit_first_after.description: Prefixes after which hex digits are a code only when the first is 0–9, so a word that starts with the prefix still searches names.

min_length.description: The shortest search that looks names up. Default 1.

texts.description: Text by language (BCP 47 tags). en is required.

code.description: One of the 48 typing keys, or Space, by KeyboardEvent.code.

layout_id.description: <group>-<name>: two or three lowercase letters, then one or more parts of lowercase letters and digits, joined by hyphens. 48 characters at most.

data.description: The name of a data buffer the harness gives the engine (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).

option.description: An option's name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

jamo_lists.description: A spelling → the jamo it reads, the default first.

t.description: What the key types there: a character or more for text (x), or its one letter, jamo, kana or mark.

r.description: The slot's role. x: text, typed as it is (every way of reading). l: a letter, of a word, a spelling or the search (direct, table, search). c: a consonant, both an initial and a final (hangul). i: an initial only. f: a final only. v: a vowel. b: a break between syllables, which types nothing (table). k: a kana. m: a mark that attaches to the kana before it (kana).

base.description: The slot with no modifier. Left out: the JIS table's legend for the key (nothing on Space). null: the key types nothing.

alt_shift.description: The slot with ⌥⇧. Left out: ⌥⇧ + the key isn't the layout's. null: the layout takes the key and types nothing.

keys_any.description: A key code → its layers. One layer at least.
